title: Who is who at Gemini Studios
back: Office boy (frustrated poet), Subbu (No. 2, envied), the lawyer ('the opposite'), the Boss (Vasan), Stephen Spender (the poet nobody understood).

title: Poets and Pancakes — the sketches in order
back: Pancake → office boy → Subbu → the opposite → MRA → Spender and The God That Failed.

back: Pancake was the brand; the room in Clive's old stables, with incandescent lights, existed to make people presentable under studio lights by first making them hideous. The humour starts here.

back: Loyal to the Boss, inventive beyond need, a poet for the masses, novelist of Thillana Mohanambal, a supporting actor who outshone leads, host to dozens — and therefore envied.

back: He switched on the recorder during the actress's outburst and played it back; she lost her voice and her nerve. Logic in a room of dreamers — the author suggests no malice.

title: Sunrise and sunset, MRA style

back: The Moral Re-Armament Army (1952, 200 people, 20 nationalities) came to counter communism; Gemini loved the sets, and Tamil plays copied the sunrise–sunset scene for years.

title: The book from the pavement
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Six ex-communists — and the name on the cover" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="90" y="60" width="140" height="90" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="3"/><text x="160" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">THE GOD</text><text x="160" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">THAT FAILED</text><text x="260" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Spender</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Six ex-communists — and the name on the cover</text></svg>
back: Years later the author buys the book cheap and finds Stephen Spender among the essayists: the poet nobody understood at Gemini, editor of The Encounter. The anti-communist Boss's guest was an ex-communist.
